Meet Meriem

Migrated standalone entry; this directory keeps a compact answer only.

Quick answer: Meet Meriem at the airport entrance to begin the ranch introduction.

Key differences and stop points

  • Meet Meriem at the airport entrance.
  • Configured for the farm owner; this is not a separate objective for every co-op visitor.
  • The success configuration starts A new begining!, the drive to your ranch.

Feathered Foes

Migrated standalone entry; this directory keeps a compact answer only.

Quick answer: Craft and build a scarecrow, checking which variant the placement objective accepts.

Key differences and stop points

  • If the Workbench is still locked, craft the ordinary Scarecrow, not Bob the Scarecrow; the ordinary current-build recipe does not require a workbench.
  • The two checks accept different variants. Bob satisfies the first condition but is not listed in the final build condition.
  • The task introduction describes scarecrows as crop protection against birds; no protection radius is specified here.

Tame the Meter!

Migrated standalone entry; this directory keeps a compact answer only.

Quick answer: Community label for the objective that distinguishes the basic ground panel from the roof version.

Key differences and stop points

  • The final check is electricity efficiency, not simply owning one panel. This configuration gives no fixed panel count or numeric efficiency target.

Coal delivery (dialogue-defined)

Migrated standalone entry; this directory keeps a compact answer only.

Quick answer: A current-build dialogue checks for eight Charcoal, removes them on handoff and configures a 300,000 C completion payment.

Key differences and stop points

  • This lead is defined in dialogue, not the static quest table; runtime availability and its starting trigger remain unknown.
  • The completion dialogue and script both configure 300,000 C; this is build configuration, not a guaranteed live reward.
  • Completion also schedules builder and clothing-store follow-up messages; exact timing and availability are unverified.
